brief: Our onboarding activation went from 14% to 67% — the 5 changes that moved the needle.

slots.title: Stop losing
slots.description: Our onboarding activation went from 14% to 67% with five tactical changes. Here's the exact before-and-after breakdown.

slots.title: Fix the
slots.description: We replaced our bloated onboarding with a focused activation flow. The impact was immediate and measurable.
slots.badText: Users hit a seven-field form and a blank dashboard with no clear next step.
slots.goodText: A three-field signup leads into a personalized checklist with one clear action.

slots.title: Cut form
slots.description: Long forms killed momentum. We cut fields by 70% and moved questions later in the journey.
slots.badText: Seven required fields including company size and phone number blocked every signup.
slots.goodText: Three fields and progressive profiling raised completions without hurting data quality.

slots.title: Add guided
slots.description: Blank dashboards overwhelm new users. We added a simple checklist to show clear progress.
slots.badText: Users landed on an empty project page and had no idea what to do first.
slots.goodText: A three-task checklist with a progress bar drove users to their first aha moment.

slots.title: Send smart
slots.description: Generic drip campaigns failed. We switched to behavior-based emails triggered by real user actions.
slots.badText: A one-size-fits-all weekly newsletter had no connection to actual user progress.
slots.goodText: Targeted nudges fired when users stalled at a specific step in the funnel.

slots.title: Offer live
slots.description: Support tickets took 48 hours. We added in-app chat to answer questions during setup.
slots.badText: Users sent emails and waited days for help with basic setup blockers.
slots.goodText: In-app chat and canned responses cut support time to under five minutes.

slots.title: Celebrate quick
slots.description: Users never felt progress. We added micro-confetti and success messages at key milestones.
slots.badText: Reaching a milestone felt silent and users had no emotional reason to return.
slots.goodText: Small celebrations after the first export created a habit loop and dopamine hit.

slots.body: Steal our 5-step onboarding framework and turn signups into power users this quarter.
